# `theta_intersection_agg`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
theta_intersection_agg(expr)
```

Returns the ThetaSketch's Compact binary representation
by intersecting all the Theta sketches in the input column.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- theta_intersection_agg, example 1
> SELECT theta_sketch_estimate(theta_intersection_agg(sketch)) FROM (SELECT theta_sketch_agg(col) as sketch FROM VALUES (1) tab(col) UNION ALL SELECT theta_sketch_agg(col, 20) as sketch FROM VALUES (1) tab(col));
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```
